title: chat-server: Message/set senderMsgId should equal id
description: handle_message_set builds Message::new(PLACEHOLDER_ID, Id::from(create_id), ...) so an owner-composed Message stores the client creation id as senderMsgId, and MemoryBackend::create_object rewrites only id. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 L603: senderMsgId 'Equals id for messages composed by the owner.' Effect: reused creation ids (m1) collide in find_message_by_sender_msg_id / store_server_message dedup (JMAP-53vd) and the federation replyTo translation (fed L394). Found while doing JMAP-53vd; out of scope there.
